_comment: Tier-2 for sparta axisymmetric: there is no 'global ... axisymmetric' keyword; axisymmetry is the boundary letter 'a' on the LOWER y face only, so the single-letter 'boundary p a p' is always an error and the two-letter 'boundary o ar p' is required. Feeds eight wrong variants to the binary and matches each error string, confirms both correct forms run, and shows the 2d-only restriction is checked at RUN SETUP — a 3d deck with 'boundary o ar p' and no 'run' exits 0.
